files.description: Canonical product truth: what Heiwa is, what the runtime owns, and what is deferred. Use this to judge whether a change's framing and scope are accurate.
Repo spine (which path owns which role), provider truth, operator/infra truth, and the agentic runtime workflow including port and runtime-identity rules.
Hard rules and current product truth, including which surfaces are live and which were removed from the tree.
Task decomposition. Use it to judge whether a PR is scoped to one task.
Development loop, branch/worktree convention, and PR expectations including required verification commands.
What CI already gates: Trivy scan, and Rust build/test/clippy on ubuntu, macos, and windows. Do not duplicate these checks in review comments.
